title: Cron lab
description: Build cron expressions visually, read them in plain English and check when they run next.
needs: an object with crons ([{ id, expression, timezone, from, expectNext }]), at least one: from is the ISO time the runs count from ("" for 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z) and expectNext the ISO time the first run should be ("" for none)

tools.name: setExpression
tools.description: Replace an expression (5 fields or a macro such as @daily).

tools.name: setField
tools.description: Replace one field of an expression: minute, hour, day, month or weekday.

tools.name: addCron
tools.description: Add an expression (timezone UTC); it gets the next free id (c1, c2, …).

tools.name: reorderCrons
tools.description: Move an expression to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: setTimezone
tools.description: Change the timezone of an expression (an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin): its runs stay computed in UTC, and also read in that zone.

tools.name: setFrom
tools.description: Set the ISO time an expression's runs count from, or "" for the default (2025-01-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: setExpectedNext
tools.description: Set the ISO time an expression's first run should be, or "" to clear it.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: An expression's English description, each field's text and values, and its next 5 runs.

tools.name: nextRuns
tools.description: The next count runs of an expression (count from 1 to 100), as UTC ISO times.
